biography.value:
Defense

AC 18 (20), touch 14 (16); flat-footed 14 (+3 armor, +3 dex, +1 natural, +1 dodge, +2 dodge in caves or rocky terrain)

hp 26 [40] (4d8+8)

Fort +3, Ref +8, Will +2, +4 racial bonus on Constitution and Fortitude saves to avoid fatigue and exhaustion;

Defensive Abilities Bond to the Land, Nimble +1, Thick Hide; Resist Earth 5;

Offense

Speed 30 ft., burrow 20 ft.

Melee Morningstar +3 (1d8)

Ranged Pistol +6 touch (2d4+4/19-20)

Space 5 ft.; Reach 5 ft.

Special Attack Deeds, Grit (2 pts)

Special Abilities Cover Fire (DC 15 Reflex), Magic Hammer

Statistics

Str 10, Dex 16, Con 14, Int 12, Wis 14, Cha 10

Base Atk +3; CMB +3; CMD 16

Feats Point-Blank Shot, Precise Shot

Skills Acrobatics +9, Knowledge (engineering, technology) +8, Perception +10, Sleight of Hand +9; Racial Modifiers +2 disable device, +2 Knowledge (dungeoneering), and +2 Survival (underground)

Languages Common, Goblin, Terran

SQ Cave Dweller, Emissary, Flanking Fire, Gun Training +1 (pistol), Gunner Style (Rapid Reload), Gunsmith, Master Tinker, Precision Aiming +1, Reckless Work, Sharp-Shooting

Gear cure potion (2), Morningstar, pistol, pistol ammo (20), studded leather armor

description.value: Kobolds have vast knowledge on dungeons and survival and therefore gain a +2 racial bonus on Knowledge (dungeoneering) and Survival checks made underground.

contextNotes.text: Apply +2 racial bonus to Knowledge (dungeoneering) and Survival checks made underground.

description.value: Kobolds are decent on making trade offers to the once famous pirates of Lominsa and know exactly how to swindle their way into getting precious metals and ores. Once per day, kobolds can roll twice when making a Bluff or Diplomacy check and take the better roll.

effect: Roll Bluff or Diplomacy twice and take the better result.

description.value: Once per day, a kobold can summon a magical hammer and launches (+8 ranged touch attack) it at a single target within 30 feet for 1d4 points of MP damage. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 1st level spell (Knowledge: Local DC 17).

effect: Once per day, a kobold can summon a magical hammer and launches (+8 ranged touch attack) it at a single target within 30 feet for 1d4 points of MP damage. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 1st level spell (Knowledge: Local DC 17).
Damage is to MP, not HP. Blue Magic: Knowledge (local) DC 17.

specialAbility.blueMage: Blue mages may learn this ability as a 1st level spell (Knowledge: Local DC 17).

description.value: Like goblins, kobolds are excellent at taking things apart, thought not as much as putting them back together and gain a +2 racial bonus on Disable Device skill checks. Kobolds are also treated as proficient with any weapon they have personally “crafted”.

contextNotes.text: Treated as proficient with any weapon it has personally crafted.

description.value: Kobolds receive a +4 racial bonus on Constitution checks and Fortitude saves to avoid fatigue and exhaustion, as well as any other ill effects from running, forced marches, starvation, thirst, and hot or cold environments.

contextNotes.text: Apply +4 racial bonus on Constitution checks and Fortitude saves against fatigue, exhaustion, forced marches, starvation, thirst, and hot or cold environments.
+4 racial against fatigue, exhaustion, and effects of running, forced marches, starvation, thirst, or extreme temperatures; also applies on Constitution checks.

description.value: Kobolds have thick hair all over them and gain a +1 natural armor bonus to their Armor Class.

contextNotes.text: Natural armor bonus is included in the source AC; do not apply a second stacking bonus unless recalculating AC from scratch.

Rapid Reload (Pistol)
Cover Fire

effect: Shoot the occupied square (AC 10); expend ammo. No ordinary damage. A confirmed critical against the opponent can deal normal damage. Cannot use if there is a miss chance.

description.value: Steady Aim

effect: With at least 1 grit, increase firearm range increment by 10 ft.

description.value: Sure Shot

effect: Spend 1 grit before firing. On a miss deal half of the precision damage only.

description.value: Quick Clear

effect: With grit available: remove the misfire's broken condition as a standard action, or spend 1 grit to do it as a move action.

description.value: Pistol-Whip

effect: Spend 1 grit; on a hit attempt a free trip.

description.value: Gunner's Dodge

effect: Spend 1 grit against a ranged attack: move 5 ft. for +2 AC or drop prone for +4 AC against that attack.

description.value: Deadeye

effect: Spend 1 grit per increment beyond the first to attack touch AC; range penalties still apply.

description.value: Gunner Initiative
+2 initiative while at least one grit remains. Published init +3 is before this situational deed.
